parole.significato: the act of guessing, sensing, suspecting; a clue, idea
parole.testo: ane + -else, verbal noun form of ane (“guess, sense; suspect”), from Low German anen. Last part from West Germanic loanwords, from Middle Low German -nisse, from Old Saxon -nissi, from Proto-West Germanic *-nassī (forms abstract nouns), from *-nass, from Proto-Germanic *-inassuz + *-ī, from Proto-Ge
